name: L.O.V.E ~Promise With Me~
source:
Korea's first commercial otome game.

The protagonist (nameable but whose Christian name is Vivianna) met a mysterious boy playing the piano when she was seven, but he moved away the very next day, only leaving her a music box. Ten years later, Vivianna has become a lazy unkept teenager, and she gets mocked by a classmate and her boyfriend for her appereance. Realizing she has to better herself and stop wallowing in self pity, Vivianna decides to work hard to give herself a makeover and meet the boy of her dreams!
translation:
韩国第一款商业化乙女游戏。

主角（可说出名字，但教名维维安娜）七岁时遇到了一个弹钢琴的神秘男孩，但第二天他就搬走了，只给她留下了一个音乐盒。十年后，薇薇安娜变成了一个懒惰不修边幅的少女，她因外表而遭到同学和男友的嘲笑。薇薇安娜意识到自己必须改善自己，停止沉溺于自怜之中，她决定努力改造自己，并遇见她的梦中情人！
